sentences.en: I entered the masjid whilst the salaah had begun.

parts.label: a
parts.ask: Classify the blue-underlined clause: is it حال? If so, tick which واو ruling (وجوب الواو | جواز الواو | منع الواو) applies to the واو حالية.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: Explain why you chose what you chose.
parts.answer: The "entering of the masjid" was done whilst "salah had started" so that becomes haal - and since it's a jumla ismiyah without a dhameer raabit, it requires a waaw haaliyah.

sentences.ar: رَأيتُ مَنْ في المسجد مصلِّياً أو هُوَ جَالِسٌ
sentences.en: I saw the one who was in the masjid whilst praying or sitting.

parts.label: a
parts.ask: For each blue-underlined item, tick whether it is حال and, if so, which واو ruling applies.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: Explain why you chose what you chose.
parts.answer:
"The one who was in the masjid" was either "praying" or "sitting".
Here, both are haal. The "sitting" does not take a waaw haaliyyah because it is mufrad and not a jumla, and the part after وl also does not require a waaw haaliyah because it is a jumla ismiyah beginning with the dhameer rabit and is ataf to a haal preceding it.
